lines.hanzi: 我最喜欢的城市是杭州。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zuì xǐhuan de chéngshì shì Hángzhōu.

lines.hanzi: 杭州在南方，西湖很有名。
lines.pinyin: Hángzhōu zài nánfāng, Xīhú hěn yǒumíng.
lines.english: Hangzhou is in the south, West Lake is very famous.

lines.hanzi: 我去过两次，每次都待一周。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ qù guò liǎng cì, měi cì dōu dāi yī zhōu.
lines.english: I've been there twice, each time stayed a week.

lines.hanzi: 西湖边走走，看山看水，很放心。
lines.pinyin: Xīhú biān zǒuzou, kàn shān kàn shuǐ, hěn fàngxīn.
lines.english: Walk by West Lake, see mountains see water, very relaxing.

lines.hanzi: 杭州的茶也很好，龙井茶世界闻名。
lines.pinyin: Hángzhōu de chá yě hěn hǎo, Lóngjǐng chá shìjiè wénmíng.
lines.english: Hangzhou's tea is also good, Longjing tea world famous.

lines.hanzi: 那里的菜清淡，不辣，我喜欢吃。
lines.pinyin: Nàlǐ de cài qīngdàn, bù là, wǒ xǐhuan chī.
lines.english: The food there is light, not spicy, I like to eat it.

lines.hanzi: 城市很干净，地铁方便，去哪儿都容易。
lines.pinyin: Chéngshì hěn gānjìng, dìtiě fāngbiàn, qù nǎr dōu róngyì.
lines.english: The city is very clean, subway convenient, going anywhere easy.

lines.hanzi: 人也很友好，说吴语，听起来很轻柔。
lines.pinyin: Rén yě hěn yǒuhǎo, shuō Wúyǔ, tīng qǐlai hěn qīngróu.
lines.english: People also very friendly, speak Wu dialect, sounds very gentle.

lines.hanzi: 希望以后有机会住在杭州。
lines.pinyin: Xīwàng yǐhòu yǒu jīhuì zhù zài Hángzhōu.
lines.english: Hope in the future have chance to live in Hangzhou.
